Rashi on Nedarim 57a:1:1.hebrew: בדבר שזרעו כלה - בקרקע וגדל, כגון חטה וכיוצא בה, דהיינו גידולין גמורין:
Rashi on Nedarim 57a:1:1.english: With regard to an item whose seed ceases - in the ground and grows, such as wheat and the like, which are complete growths.

Rashi on Nedarim 57a:1:2.hebrew: אבל בדבר שאין זרעו כלה - כגון השומים והבצלים, שאינו כלה בקרקע אלא שרבה וגדל בגופו:
Rashi on Nedarim 57a:1:2.english: However, with regard to an item whose seeds do not cease - Such as garlic and onions, where [the seed] does not cease in the ground, rather it increases and grows in its own substance.

Rashi on Nedarim 57a:1:3.english: Even the growths of growths are prohibited - For they are like [the original items] themselves.

Rashi on Nedarim 57a:2:1.hebrew: מעשה ידיך עלי - ונתנו לה פירות בשכר מעשה ידיה, הואיל ואמר עלי, אסור בחילופיהן וט'. אבל כי אמר שאיני טועם, משמע מהן גופן איני טועם; הלכך, מותר בחילופיהן ובגידוליהן אם זרעו וצמחו:
Rashi on Nedarim 57a:2:1.english: Your handicraft [is] upon me - And they gave her produce as wages for her handicraft; since he said "upon me," he is prohibited from their replacements, etc. However, when he said "that I will not taste," it implies: from them themselves I will not taste; therefore, he is permitted [to benefit] from their replacements and from their growths if they were sown and sprouted.

Rashi on Nedarim 57a:3:1.hebrew: שאת עושה איני אוכל עדי הפסח - דאמר הכי, קונם עלי מה שאת עושה שאיני אוכל ממעשה ידיך עד הפסח, או שאמר קונם שאת עושה שאיני מתכסה מכל מלאכתך עד הפסח:
Rashi on Nedarim 57a:3:1.english: [That] which you prepare, I will not eat until Passover - For he said thus: "Konam upon me what you prepare, that I will not eat from your handiwork until Passover," or he said, "Konam [what] you prepare, that I will not cover myself from any of your work until Passover."

Rashi on Nedarim 57a:3:2.english: [It is] permitted after Passover - For he only vowed [to abstain] from whatever she makes until Passover.

Rashi on Nedarim 57a:3:3.hebrew: אפי' אחר הפסח אסור - לאכול ולהתכסות מכל שעושה לעולם, שהרי לא קבע בו זמן:
Rashi on Nedarim 57a:3:3.english: Even after Passover it is prohibited - to eat or to cover himself from anything that she makes, forever, since he did not set a time [limit] for it.

Rashi on Nedarim 57a:3:4.hebrew: היה עומד באדר ואמר: "קונם שאת נהנית לי עד הפסח אם תלכי לבית אביך מעכשיו עד החג", הלכה לפני הפסח — אסורה בהנאתו עד הפסח:
Rashi on Nedarim 57a:3:4.english: [If a man] was standing in Adar and said: "Konam [be any benefit] that you derive from me until Passover if you go to your father's house from now until the Festival [of Sukkot]," [and] she went before Passover — she is forbidden to derive benefit from him until Passover.

Tosafot on Nedarim 57a:1:1.hebrew: קונם פירות האלו עלי - ולא גרסי' פירות אלו:
Tosafot on Nedarim 57a:1:1.english: "This produce is konam upon me" - And we do not read [the text as] peirot eilu.

Tosafot on Nedarim 57a:1:2.hebrew: אסור בחילופיהן ובגידוליהן - דכיון דהזכיר קונם סתם ולא הזכיר אכילה, אסר עצמו בין בחילופיהן בין בגידוליהן:
Tosafot on Nedarim 57a:1:2.english: [He] is prohibited from their replacements and from their growths - For since he mentioned konam without specification and did not mention eating, he prohibited himself both from their replacements and from their growths.

Tosafot on Nedarim 57a:1:3.english: "That I eat," "that I taste" - He prohibited himself only from the substance of the produce.

Tosafot on Nedarim 57a:1:4.english: With regard to an item whose seed ceases - the growths are like another entity.

Tosafot on Nedarim 57a:1:5.hebrew: אבל בדבר שאין זרעו כלה אפילו גידולי גידולין אסורין - כגון בצלים, שאין הבצל כלה אלא מוסיף אחרים עליו; הלכך גידולין כגופן:
Tosafot on Nedarim 57a:1:5.english: However, with regard to an item whose seed does not cease, even growths of growths are prohibited - For example, onions, for the onion [bulb] does not cease [to exist], rather it adds others onto itself; therefore, [its] growths are like its [original] body.

Tosafot on Nedarim 57a:2:1.hebrew: האומר לאשתו קונם מעשה ידיך - פי': אם תעשה לי מאכל. אסור בחלופיהן — אם הכינה לו מאכל והחליפן בפירות. בגידולין — פי': בגידולי פירות שלקח מן החליפין:
Tosafot on Nedarim 57a:2:1.english: "One who says to his wife: Your handicraft is konam [upon me]" - Meaning, if she makes food for me. "He is prohibited [from benefiting] from their replacements" — if she prepared food for him and exchanged it for fruit. "[And] from their growths" — meaning, from the growths of the fruit that he acquired from the replacements.

Tosafot on Nedarim 57a:2:2.hebrew: שאני טועם מותר בחליפין - שלא אסר עצמו אלא מהם. אבל בדבר שאין זרעו כלה, אסור בגידולי גידוליהן; ומשכחת לה כגון שנטע אילן או זרע דבר שאין זרעו כלה, ונמצא שהגידולין אסורין עליהן, דהיינו כמו מעשה ידיה, והלכך גידולי גידולין אסורין בדבר שאין זרעו כלה. אבל בדבר שזרעו כלה, הגידולין אסורין וגידולי גידולין מותרין:
Tosafot on Nedarim 57a:2:2.english: "[That] I taste" — [it] is permitted in [regard to] replacements - because he only forbade himself from them [the original items]. However, with regard to an item whose seed does not cease, it is prohibited [even] in the growths of their growths; and you find this [case] where, for example, he planted a tree or sowed an item whose seed does not cease, and it turns out that the growths are prohibited [to him], for that is like her handicraft [itself], and therefore the growths of growths are prohibited with regard to an item whose seed does not cease. However, with regard to an item whose seed ceases, the [first] growths are prohibited, while the growths of growths are permitted.

Tosafot on Nedarim 57a:3:1.hebrew: קונם שאת עושה איני אוכל עד הפסח - ממה שאת עושה. ואשמועינן דלא תימא דה"ק: "איני אוכל מכל מה שתעשה עד הפסח לעולם"; וכן כולם אשמועינן הכי:
Tosafot on Nedarim 57a:3:1.english: Konam, [from] that which you prepare, I will not eat until Passover - [This means] "from that which you prepare." And [the Mishnah] teaches us [this] so that you should not say that this is what he is saying: "I will not eat forever from anything that you prepare until Passover"; and similarly [for] all of them, it teaches us thus.

Tosafot on Nedarim 57a:3:2.hebrew: שאת נהנית לי עד הפסח אם תלכי לבית אביך עד החג - עומד בחודש אחד לפני הפסח, ואמר: "קונם שלא תהא נהנית לי עד הפסח אם תלכי לבית אביך מעכשיו ועד החג", והלכה לפני הפסח — אסורה עד הפסח; כלומר, אם הלכה לבית אביה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 57a:3:2.english: "[Konam] that you benefit from me until Passover if you go to your father's house until the festival [of Sukkot]" - [He] is standing one month before Passover and said: "Konam that you shall not benefit from me until Passover if you go to your father's house from now until the festival [of Sukkot]," and she went before Passover — she is forbidden [to benefit from him] until Passover; that is to say, if she went to her father's house [before Passover].
